subject: MATH150
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering the specified topics in discrete mathematics. The English selections are from highly-rated channels like Dr. Trefor Bazett, Neso Academy, and Kimberly Brehm, chosen for their clarity and direct relevance. The Arabic selections feature popular educational series from Dr. Ahmed Hagag and others, providing strong, university-level content. For 'Propositional Satisfiability' in Arabic, a video on the foundational concepts of tautology and contradiction was chosen as the best available eligible option.

coverage.note: Highly relevant candidates failed gates (views, duration). Selected video teaches the prerequisite concepts (Tautology, Contradiction) needed to determine satisfiability.

videos.title: Conditional Statements: if p then q
videos.filter_reason: A perfectly focused video from a top-tier educator that directly addresses the common student confusion around implications with a false hypothesis.

videos.title: Converse, Contrapositive and Inverse
videos.topic_ar: العبارات الشرطية المرتبطة (العكس، المعكوس، المعاكس الإيجابي)
videos.filter_reason: A very concise and clear explanation from Neso Academy that defines converse, inverse, and contrapositive and highlights their logical equivalences.

videos.title: Discrete Math - 1.3.3 Constructing New Logical Equivalences
videos.filter_reason: This video focuses on applying logical laws to construct new equivalences, which directly addresses the difficult skill of manipulating logical expressions.

videos.title: Discrete Math - 1.2.3 Introduction to Logic Circuits
videos.filter_reason: An excellent introduction from a full discrete math course that teaches both how to interpret and how to construct logic circuits from propositions.

videos.title: Tautology, Contradiction, Contingency & Satisfiability
videos.filter_reason: This Neso Academy video provides a clear, concise definition of satisfiability and explains it in context with the related concepts of tautology, contradiction, and contingency.

videos.title: رياضيات متقطعة Ch1المنطق conditional statement المقطع الثالث
videos.filter_reason: A dedicated university-level lecture on conditional statements, providing an in-depth explanation of implication, sufficient/necessary conditions, and various forms.

videos.title: العكس و المعكوس و المعاكس الايجابي
videos.topic_ar: العبارات الشرطية المرتبطة (العكس، المعكوس، المعاكس الإيجابي)
videos.filter_reason: A clear, well-explained video with good examples and a high view count, focusing entirely on defining and differentiating the converse, inverse, and contrapositive.

videos.title: 05–Discrete Math | Ch1-5 | Propositional Equivalences | رياضيات متقطعة | التكافؤ المنطقي
videos.filter_reason: This is the most popular and comprehensive video on the topic in Arabic, from a highly-regarded discrete mathematics series, covering the laws in detail.

videos.title: طريقة استنتاج الدائرة المنطقية و جدول الحقيقه من المعادله المنطقية
videos.filter_reason: An extremely popular and effective tutorial that directly teaches the core skill of translating a logical equation into a visual logic circuit and its truth table.

videos.title: الدرس الثالث  Logically Equivalent
videos.filter_reason: While not explicitly about 'satisfiability', this high-quality, popular video thoroughly explains tautologies, contradictions, and contingencies, which are the concepts required to determine if a proposition is satisfiable.
